about_the_game:
Note: The offer is available as part of the Warhammer Skulls Sale, running in WoT Blitz from May 22 through May 29.
If you already have this vehicle, you will receive 3,500 gold as compensation. Compensation for each camouflage is 950 gold.

This bundle includes:

• Predator UM
• Garage slot
• 9 equipment slots for the Predator UM
• Dark Angels Legendary camouflage
• Imperial Fists Legendary camouflage
• 30 certificates for x5 XP for the Predator UM
• Roboute Guilliman profile background
• Imperial Fortress profile background
• Imperial Aquila Legendary avatar

The Predator Ultramarines is a dynamic heavy tank armed with a rapid-firing gun featuring a three-shell magazine. The combination of its fast turret, minimal dispersion after firing, and well-balanced armor makes the Predator Ultramarines a formidable opponent for enemy tanks.

This DLC can be added to your World of Tanks Blitz account only once.
